physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the adrenals, the two small glands that ride on top of the kidneys and decide, faster than thought, whether the body is safe or under attack. They are the warrior's organ. They pour out the chemistry of fight, the kick that lets a person run into something instead of away from it. It is fitting that the code of struggle and perseverance is wired here. The teaching of this card is not abstract. It is happening in two glands the size of grapes, every time the day asks more than the body wanted to give.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. The held breath, the locked jaw, the shoulders climbing toward the ears, all of it is the adrenals firing without anywhere to send the charge. The body is producing a warrior chemistry for a fight that has no target, so the chemistry just stays in the tissues, and tension is the name for that. Long stretches of it wear the glands down. The fatigue that the shadow calls laziness is often only this. A body that has been ready for a fight for years and has never been allowed to actually have one.

The climb out is also bodily, and almost too plain to name. The breath returns. The shoulders drop a fraction. The charge finds a real thing to push against, and what was tension becomes movement, and the glands finally do what they were built to do.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to a single amino acid, Arginine. Arginine is what the body uses to make nitric oxide, the small molecule that tells the blood vessels to open. Under stress, under the call to act, it is the substance that widens the channel so the blood can actually get to the muscle that needs it.

There is a teaching in that. The warrior code does not live in the punch. It lives in the opening of the vessel that lets the punch happen. The willingness to let more through. The shadow is a vessel clamped shut, a body that has been told to fight and given nowhere for the blood to go. The gift is the same chemistry meeting an open road.

Arginine is also called conditionally essential. The body usually makes its own, but under hard stress, illness, injury, real demand, it needs more from outside than it can make. The chemistry says the same thing the card has been saying. There are fights you cannot meet on your own supply. You have to be fed for them.
